## Deep Reveal panel data contract
Answer: Client reuses evaluate-move data (Recommended) — patternTag/quality/badge come from the already-held evaluate-move response (Epic 2a client state). LLM endpoint extends to return only `explanation` + `bestLine` (solver principal variation). No duplicate classifier call.

## Cache wiring for /api/explain-move-llm
Answer: Accept recommendation — Epic 2b adds read+write cache logic to `/api/explain-move-llm` (key: SHA256(movestring+':'+col)). Store the LLM's explanation in `deep_reveal_json`. Return cached value immediately on hit.

## Cache hit quota consumption
Answer: Accept recommendation — Cache hits do NOT consume quota. Move the decrement to after the cache-miss branch in `/api/explain-move-llm`. Spec must call this out explicitly.

## forced_win scoring contract
Answer: 1 item per puzzle via SequenceHandler result (Recommended) — whole-line pass/fail. Reuses existing SequenceHandler completion result. Does NOT wire `/api/evaluate-move` into each sequence move. Epic line claiming 'scorer applies per move' must be corrected to say 'whole-line pass/fail via SequenceHandler'.

## Post-Set Summary single-category behavior
Answer: Accept recommendation — Show the single pattern row. If accuracy < threshold recommend re-doing its lesson. If 100% show congratulatory CTA. Spec explicitly calls out single-vs-mixed distinction.

## track('set_completed') payload for mixed sets
Answer: Accept recommendation — Keep `category` as-is (including 'mixed'). Optionally add `byPattern` object. Low priority.

## Deep Reveal 'Best line' source
Answer: Solver principal variation, server-side (Recommended) — server computes top line from solver and returns `bestLine` column array in /api/explain-move-llm. Deterministic and cheap.

## forced_win provisional star rating
Answer: 3 stars (Recommended) — hardest free pattern; multi-move recognition. Final value confirmed in Epic 6.
